description: Write one document in the user's brand and save it to their files: anything they want to read in chat rather than print or send, from a to-do list or a checklist to a plan, notes, a brief or a summary they asked to keep. Takes the markdown, an optional title (the first heading otherwise) and an optional brand_kit_id. The card renders the whole document in the brand, so never paste the markdown into the reply as well. Nothing renders to a file the user has to open: there is no watermark, nothing to unlock and nothing to pay. Use generate_pdf instead when they want a document to print, attach or send. Do not call this again to retry.

title.description: The document title. The first heading otherwise.
